title: Departing-Customer Tenure Bonus on Rental Sale Cancellations
content:
**Bonus rule.** The departing-customer tenure bonus on a Rental Property Service Contracts sale cancellation credit is 0.04 when the contract's original purchase date is 1095 days or more before the notice date, 0.02 when it is 730 to 1094 days before it, and 0 otherwise.

| Days from the original purchase date to the notice date | Bonus |
|---|---|
| 1095 or more | 0.04 |
| 730 to 1094 | 0.02 |
| fewer than 730 | 0 |

The original purchase date is the start date on the contract; the notice date is the one on the cancellation request.

**How the bonus acts.** Every bonus on a sale cancellation credit is added to one in a single sum, and the credit is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* a contract purchased 800 days before the notice date: 0.02; one purchased 1100 days before: 0.04.
